decision.rationale: TXN-008009 is a payment of 107.42 EUR to Riverside Outfitters (MER-000060) on card CRD-000214. It posted on 2026-10-10. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 16 days after posting, which is inside the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000043 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-19. The dispute was opened 7 days after that date. The policy says a cardholder must wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, and a dispute opened sooner is declined. Because the case was opened too early, I did not go on to check for proof of delivery or a merchant refund. Neither the statement nor the document contains an instruction to the bank. The cardholder may open a new dispute from 2026-11-03, the day the 15-day wait ends, if the order still has not arrived.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order from Riverside Outfitters was due on 2026-10-19, and you opened this dispute 7 days later. A dispute for goods not received can only be opened once 15 days have passed since the expected delivery date, so that a late parcel still has time to arrive. If the order has still not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-11-03.
